headword: {事業計画|じぎょうけいかく}

definitions.explanation: A formal document or strategy outlining the objectives, methods, timeline, and financial projections for a business venture or project. Used in corporate, governmental, and nonprofit contexts.

examples.japanese: {事業計画|じぎょうけいかく}を{策定|さくてい}する。
{銀行|ぎんこう}に{事業計画|じぎょうけいかく}を{提出|ていしゅつ}した。
examples.english: I submitted the business plan to the bank.

examples.japanese: {新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}を{始|はじ}めるには、しっかりとした{事業計画|じぎょうけいかく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: To start a new business, you need a solid business plan.

notes:
Composed of {事業|じぎょう} (business, project, enterprise) and {計画|けいかく} (plan). A fundamental term in business and government contexts. Often required when seeking bank loans, applying for grants, or proposing new projects within organizations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事業計画|じぎょうけいかく}を{策定|さくてい}する: to formulate a business plan
- {事業計画|じぎょうけいかく}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit a business plan
- {事業計画|じぎょうけいかく}{書|しょ}: business plan document
- {中期|ちゅうき}{事業計画|じぎょうけいかく}: medium-term business plan

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ビジネスプラン: business plan — the English loanword, common in startup culture
- {経営|けいえい}{計画|けいかく}: management plan — broader, covering overall company strategy
- {企画|きかく}{書|しょ}: project proposal — a document proposing a specific project or idea, less comprehensive than a full business plan
